name: Fields of The World (FTW): Global Agricultural Field Boundary Benchmark
description: Fields of The World (FTW) is an open-access, community-driven global benchmark dataset designed for agricultural field boundary instance and semantic segmentation. Maintained by Earth Genome, Taylor Geospatial Engine, and international collaborators, FTW provides multi-temporal Sentinel-2 satellite imagery paired with high-quality instance masks across diverse agricultural landscapes, biomes, and field sizes spanning Europe, Africa, Asia, and South America. The benchmark standardizes evaluation for delineating agricultural parcel boundaries at 10-meter resolution.
